title: Hole-faithful refutations of Tseitin formulas need 2^Omega(treewidth); Urquhart's conjecture is the open problem
subject: Regular versus general resolution on Tseitin formulas through the hole picture
conclusion: Refutations of Tseitin formulas that never forget a variable at the region where the hole must lie need size 2^Omega(treewidth), because the hole of a random critical assignment stays uniform there and regions fragment size-biased; Davis-Putnam refutations are of this kind. A smaller refutation must re-read variables and forget at the hole's region, and Urquhart's conjecture is equivalent to the open 2^Omega(tw) problem at bounded degree.
